<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In its monthly closing for June 2026, Adams Street Credit Solutions Fund (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) sold Class&nbsp;I common shares of beneficial interest
(the &#8220;Shares&#8221;) as of June&nbsp;1, 2026 for aggregate consideration of approximately $4.7&nbsp;million. The number of Shares to be issued was finalized on June&nbsp;25, 2026. The purchase price per Share equaled the Company&#8217;s net
asset value (&#8220;NAV&#8221;) per Share as of May&nbsp;31, 2026. The following table details the Shares issued: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
